description: Check whether an A2A agent card, MCP server or OpenAPI spec is well-formed before you install or call it. Pass only `metadata` (protocol is inferred). Returns pass/fail per rule. Set mode=VERIFY_BEFORE_CALL with `target` to get task-specific evidence about a counterparty instead. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

protocol.description: Counterparty protocol. Inferred from metadata when omitted, otherwise MCP.

name: check_agent_conformance
title: Check an agent interface
